newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Cedenco sees return to profit this year.
newsitem.headline: Cedenco sees return to profit this year.

text.p: Cedenco Foods Ltd said on Thursday it expected to return to profit in the current year following a major reconstruction.
Cedenco last year transferred all of its tomato growing and processing operation from Gisborne, in New Zealand's North Island, to Australia, where it is a 50 percent partner with Cerebos Australia.
Cedenco reported a NZ$6.1 million loss in the September year, down from a previous $3.5 million profit.
Cedenco's new factory in Echuca, Victoria, is due to be opened on February 5.
Chairman Basil Logan said the partnership with Cerebos was a key factor in the aniticpated turnaround.
Both the Australian and Gisborne operations were poised to make positive contributions to the group, Logan said.
The company had reduced debt to $5 million from $10.4 million at September 30 and from $16 million in September 1995.
Logan says Cedenco was now in a stronger, more competitive position carrying less debt and exposed to less risks in servicing its international markets.
